test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On the eve of which of the following festivals is Kotappakonda Fair of Andhra Pradesh organised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maha Shivaratri.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sri Trikoteswara Swamy temple** at **Kotappakonda hill **is one of the ancient and most famous temples in the district. 
 
• Lakhs of devotees visit the temple and participate in the** two-day fair **during the **Maha Shivaratri** festival.
 
• The highlight of the festival is the presence of lofty illuminated** ‘prabhalu,’ **made of bamboo and decorated with coloured cloth and paper. 
 
• Some of them are as tall as 60-70 feet and are carried on bullock carts. 
 
• The deity on the top of the hill shrine is in the shape of **Sivalinga **and is known as **Trikoteswara Swamy.** A steep flight of steps lead to the hill and the deity is located at a height of 1,587 feet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ugadi**

 
 
• Ugadi is New Year's Day for the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka in India.
 
• It is celebrated in these regions as a festival on the first day of the Hindu lunar calendar month of Chaitra.
